---
title: "Principles for Effective Interactive Visualizations"
format:
  revealjs:
    theme: theme/vibe-widgets.scss
    width: 1280
    height: 720
    margin: 0.055
    min-scale: 0.2
    max-scale: 2.0
    slide-number: c/t
    code-line-numbers: false
    code-copy: false
    highlight-style: a11y-dark
    html-math-method: plain
    transition: none
    background-transition: none
    progress: true
    hash: true
    center: false
    title-slide-attributes:
      data-visibility: hidden
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <script>
        /* Pause off-screen widget iframes so only the visible demo animates. */
        window.addEventListener('load', () => {
          if (!window.Reveal) return;
          Reveal.on('slidechanged', ev => {
            document.querySelectorAll('.widget-wrap iframe').forEach(f => {
              const onSlide = ev.currentSlide.contains(f);
              if (onSlide && !f.src && f.dataset.src) f.src = f.dataset.src;
            });
          });

          /* Slide 10 (the loop): bold ASK while a question is current, bold
             SEE while its answer is current, and keep only the current
             question's answer visible -- earlier answers hide again. */
          function syncLoopUI(slide) {
            if (!slide) return;
            const steps = [...slide.querySelectorAll('.fragment[data-role]')];
            if (!steps.length) return;
            const visible = steps.filter(el => el.classList.contains('visible'));
            const current = visible.length
              ? visible.reduce((a, b) => (+a.dataset.fragmentIndex > +b.dataset.fragmentIndex ? a : b))
              : null;
            const askEl = slide.querySelector('#loop-ask');
            const seeEl = slide.querySelector('#loop-see');
            if (askEl) askEl.classList.toggle('is-bold', !!current && current.dataset.role === 'ask');
            if (seeEl) seeEl.classList.toggle('is-bold', !!current && current.dataset.role === 'see');
            slide.querySelectorAll('.qa-answer').forEach(a => {
              const isCurrent = !!current && a.dataset.q === current.dataset.q && a.classList.contains('visible');
              a.classList.toggle('force-hide', !isCurrent);
            });
          }
          Reveal.on('fragmentshown', ev => syncLoopUI(Reveal.getCurrentSlide()));
          Reveal.on('fragmenthidden', ev => syncLoopUI(Reveal.getCurrentSlide()));
          Reveal.on('slidechanged', ev => syncLoopUI(ev.currentSlide));
        });
        </script>
---

#### Query Parameterization
interactions parameterize query results
:::
:::

```sql
SELECT name, distance(shop, :center) AS dist
FROM donut_shops
WHERE dist <= :radius
ORDER BY dist;
```

#### Query Structuring
manipulation of query structure by adding new clauses
:::
:::

```sql
SELECT grp, AVG(weekend_wait_min)
FROM donut_shops
WHERE grp IN ('A', 'B')
GROUP BY grp
HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;
```

#### Query Augmentation
computing results via external algorithm or service
:::
:::

```sql
SELECT d.name, w.dist, w.walk_min
FROM donut_shops d
JOIN walking_distances w
  ON w.shop_id = d.shop_id
WHERE w.origin = :me;
```
